findings.issue: cascadeTeamRules() calls client.apiCall('GET', '/rules') which resolves to /api/sync/{projectId}/rules — wrong Lambda. Team rules never cascade.
findings.recommendation: Make direct HTTP request to /api/teams/{teamId}/rules, not through sync-client.

findings.issue: pullTeamKnowledge() and checkTemplateUpdates() use /../teams/ path traversal which API Gateway V2 does not interpret. All knowledge/template API calls 404.
findings.recommendation: Use direct HTTP client targeting /api/teams/{teamId}/ paths, bypass sync-client prefix.

findings.issue: INTEGRATION_ENCRYPT_KEY env var never declared in any Lambda function's CloudFormation Environment block. All credential encrypt/decrypt throws at runtime.
findings.recommendation: Add INTEGRATION_ENCRYPT_KEY to TeamsFunction and WebhooksFunction env vars. Store key in Secrets Manager.

findings.issue: _createNewTask acquires FOR UPDATE lock outside explicit transaction. Concurrent webhooks can produce version conflicts or silent overwrites in sync_state.
findings.recommendation: Wrap SELECT FOR UPDATE → UPDATE → INSERT in explicit BEGIN/COMMIT transaction.

findings.issue: _recordUnmappedUser mutates this.config in memory then writes back to DB. Concurrent config updates overwrite each other.
findings.recommendation: Re-fetch latest config from DB before mutating, or use dedicated table.

findings.issue: If event.isBase64Encoded is true, HMAC is computed over base64 string instead of decoded bytes. Webhook signature verification fails or can be bypassed.
findings.recommendation: Check event.isBase64Encoded and decode before HMAC computation.

findings.issue: Hardcoded OAuth client ID placeholder with no runtime guard. Silent failure if deploy-time substitution fails.
findings.recommendation: Add runtime guard: if (clientId === 'GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID') { showError('OAuth not configured'); return; }

findings.issue: Client calls POST /rules/synced and GET /rules/notifications but neither route exists in team-rules.js. Sync tracking and notifications silently broken.
findings.recommendation: Add /rules/synced and /rules/notifications route handlers in team-rules.js.

findings.issue: Bitbucket advertised in ADAPTER_META and VALID_INTEGRATION_TYPES but no adapter registered. Users can create but never use Bitbucket integrations.
findings.recommendation: Remove 'bitbucket' from validate.js and ADAPTER_META until implemented.

findings.issue: sync-outbound requires admin role via blanket rule. Regular members (who complete tasks) get 403. Session-end sync broken for non-admins.
findings.recommendation: Add specific role check: sync-outbound requires 'member' not 'admin'.

findings.issue: handleConnect stores credentials and sets status 'connected' without calling adapter.connect() to validate. Invalid credentials appear connected.
findings.recommendation: Call adapter.connect(credentials) to validate before setting status to 'connected'.

findings.issue: bulkCreateModelLearnings executes N sequential SELECT+INSERT pairs with no transaction. Race condition on duplicates, O(2N) round-trips.
findings.recommendation: Use INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING with unique index. Batch with multi-row VALUES.

findings.issue: updateLastSync runs after try/catch — executes even when webhook processing fails. Masks sync failures in health monitoring.
findings.recommendation: Move updateLastSync inside try block, after successful processing.

findings.issue: Pool null-reset on error causes thundering herd — all concurrent requests race to create new pool and call Secrets Manager simultaneously.
findings.recommendation: Add promise-based initialization lock to prevent concurrent pool creation.

findings.issue: sync-outbound IDOR: getMappingsByTaskId returns cross-team mappings. Guard skipped when mapping.teamId is null/undefined.
findings.recommendation: Unconditional team ownership assertion on integration record. Hard reject instead of soft skip.

findings.issue: SSRF via configurable baseUrl — no domain allowlist. Team admin can point to internal AWS endpoints (169.254.169.254, RDS).
findings.recommendation: Validate baseUrl against allowlist (*.atlassian.net, *.jira.com). Similar for GitHub.

findings.issue: Webhook body size unbounded before JSON.parse. 9.9MB payload consumes Lambda CPU/memory.
findings.recommendation: Add MAX_WEBHOOK_BODY_SIZE (1MB) check before parsing.

findings.issue: Credentials accepted without schema validation — any JSON object stored encrypted. No type-specific checks.
findings.recommendation: Add validateCredentials(type, credentials) with type-specific schemas and size limit.

findings.issue: upsertModelProfile default-flag flip is non-atomic. Concurrent upserts can leave two profiles as default.
findings.recommendation: Wrap in transaction or use single UPDATE with CTE.

findings.issue: createTemplate/updateTemplate/setDefaultTemplate clear old default then set new one non-atomically. Crash between leaves no default.
findings.recommendation: Use transaction or single-statement approach.

findings.issue: deleteRule creates notification BEFORE deleting rule. FK cascade may delete notification. If DELETE fails, spurious notification exists.
findings.recommendation: Wrap in transaction. Delete first, then notify.

findings.issue: 6 parsing functions duplicated between github-field-mapper.js and jira-field-mapper.js. Bug fixes must be applied twice.
findings.recommendation: Extract shared utilities to field-mapper-utils.js.

findings.issue: Operator precedence bug in role check: isDelete || startsWith('shared-configs') && isWrite. Correct by luck. Fragile.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit parentheses and extract to lookup table.

findings.issue: syncOutbound returns { synced: true } even when transition fails. Caller sees success for partial sync.
findings.recommendation: Return { synced: 'partial' } to distinguish full from partial success.

findings.issue: _generateTaskId uses 8-hex SHA hash (2^32 collision space). No DB unique constraint on task_id.
findings.recommendation: Increase hash length to 12+ hex chars and add unique constraint.

findings.issue: Path traversal smell: /../teams/ construction relies on URL normalization that API Gateway does not perform.
findings.recommendation: Use absolute path construction with dedicated teams API client.

findings.issue: Duplicate detection uses substring(0,200) matching — false-positive-prone for common headers.
findings.recommendation: Use content hash (SHA-256) for deduplication.

findings.issue: Error rollback uses entries.length instead of actual added count. merged can go negative.
findings.recommendation: Track addedCount separately for rollback.

findings.issue: _isRepoSynced returns true when no repos configured (sync all mode). Any repo can send webhooks.
findings.recommendation: Require explicit opt-in to sync-all mode via config flag.

findings.issue: recordRuleSync issues N sequential queries with no batch optimization. No validation that ruleIds belong to the team.
findings.recommendation: Use multi-row INSERT with unnest(). Add team ownership validation.

findings.issue: commitLink interpolated into GitHub markdown comment without URL validation. javascript: scheme creates XSS.
findings.recommendation: Validate commitLink as HTTPS URL before use.

findings.issue: Unmapped user emails stored in config column and returned in API responses. PII leak to all team viewers.
findings.recommendation: Move to dedicated table or strip unmappedUsers from API responses.

findings.issue: Template file path traversal check incomplete — misses URL-encoded, null-byte, and Windows-style paths.
findings.recommendation: Normalize with path.normalize() and re-check. Add null-byte check.

findings.issue: handleDisconnect executes non-atomic status update then credential clear. Concurrent requests see stale state.
findings.recommendation: Combine into single UPDATE SET status='disconnected', credentials_encrypted=NULL.

findings.issue: integrations table has no updated_at column. No auditable timestamp for config changes.
findings.recommendation: Add updated_at column in new migration.

findings.issue: Lambda egress allows all protocols to 0.0.0.0/0. Overly permissive for defense-in-depth.
findings.recommendation: Restrict to port 443 (HTTPS) and 5432 (RDS) only.

findings.issue: RDS DeletionProtection: false. Single stack delete command destroys production database.
findings.recommendation: Set DeletionProtection: true for production.
